entry=("- **`afterModelResponse` now receives the usage of the whole turn, not just its last provider call.** A turn that called tools makes one provider call per round, and the hook used to be handed only the final one's `usage`, so the earlier rounds — including the one carrying the user's question and the full tool results — were counted nowhere. The hook now receives each token field summed across every provider call in the turn. A round whose provider reports no usage adds nothing to the sum rather than erasing it, and a turn in which no round reported usage still passes `undefined`. **Migration note**: a turn that ran no tools reports exactly what it did before, but for a turn that ran tools the numbers your hook records will be larger — they now reflect what the turn actually cost. A budget or billing threshold tuned against the old figures under-counted tool-heavy turns and may need revisiting.\n")

EOF
